result.instructions: Tools for Resi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which units at our Riverside property are available under $2,500 from December 1?"; "Show me the leads from the website form in the last 7 days and their lead sources."; "Which PMS sync failed for our portfolio this week, and why?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Resi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run resi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run resi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run resi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. resi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: resi_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user and accounts
tools.description: Return the Resi user who owns this token and every account that user belongs to. The token itself is pinned to one account: use resi_get_token_account to see which one. Resi API: GET /api/v2/me.

tools.name: resi_get_token_account
tools.title: Get the account this token is pinned to
tools.description: Return the id of the Resi account this token runs against (the X-Resi-Account-Id response header) and the property count there. Use it to confirm which client a token serves. Resi API: GET /api/v2/properties?per_page=1.

annotations.title: Get the account this token is pinned to

tools.name: resi_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties (communities) in the token's account, with address, contact details and status. Start here to find a property id. Resi API: GET /api/v2/properties. Properties cannot be sorted.

group.description: Group id: the group and all its descendants.

tools.name: resi_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: Return one property with its address, settings and contact details. Resi API: GET /api/v2/properties/{property}.

tools.name: resi_list_buildings
tools.title: List buildings
tools.description: List the buildings of a property (filter by property_id). Resi API: GET /api/v2/buildings.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

group.description: Group id: the group and all its descendants.

tools.name: resi_list_floor_plans
tools.title: List floor plans
tools.description: List floor plans with bedroom range, size and rent range. Filter by property_id, name or bedroom count. Resi API: GET /api/v2/floor-plans.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

min_bedrooms.description: Only plans with at least this many bedrooms.

max_bedrooms.description: Only plans with at most this many bedrooms.

group.description: Group id: the group and all its descendants.

tools.name: resi_list_units
tools.title: List units
tools.description: List apartment units with rent, availability and bedrooms. Use is_available=true and a rent range to answer 'what can I rent'. Filters run on Resi, which saves quota. Resi API: GET /api/v2/units.

number.description: Unit number (partial match; also matches the building-prefixed form, e.g. 149-304).

min_rent.description: Monthly leasing price (base rent plus mandatory fees) at least this value.

max_rent.description: Monthly leasing price at most this value.

is_hidden.description: Hidden from public sites (true) or shown (false).

available_from.description: Available on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO).

available_by.description: Available on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO).

group.description: Group id: the group and all its descendants.

sort.description: One field to sort by, e.g. number or -min_rent (leading minus = descending). Unknown fields are ignored.

tools.name: resi_get_unit
tools.title: Get unit
tools.description: Return one unit with its property, building, floor plan, amenities, fee breakdown and synced_fields (fields a PMS connection overwrites). Resi API: GET /api/v2/units/{unit}.

tools.name: resi_update_unit
tools.title: Update unit availability or price
tools.description: WRITE: change one unit's availability, availability date, rent, deposit, specials or description. Changes go live on the client's Resi sites. A field listed in the unit's synced_fields is overwritten by the next PMS sync. Pass only the fields to change. min_rent and max_rent are total monthly leasing prices (base rent plus mandatory fees). Resi API: PATCH /api/v2/units/{unit}. Needs a full-access token.

is_hidden.description: Hide the unit from public sites.

min_rent.description: Total monthly leasing price, low end.

max_rent.description: Total monthly leasing price, high end.

tools.name: resi_list_amenities
tools.title: List amenities
tools.description: List amenities (pool, gym, pet policy items and so on) with their codes and marketing flags. Resi API: GET /api/v2/amenities.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

property_id.description: Property id (amenities linked to this property) (UUID).

tools.name: resi_list_fees
tools.title: List fees
tools.description: List fees (application, admin, pet, utility and so on) with their class, currency and status. Resi API: GET /api/v2/fees.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

property_id.description: Property id (fees assigned to this property) (UUID).

tools.name: resi_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List resident and public reviews of a property, with rating, source and publish state. Resi API: GET /api/v2/reviews.

tools.name: resi_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads (prospect contact forms and tour bookings), newest first. Poll for new leads with created_after set to the newest created_at you hold. Contains personal data: use only for the client's own leasing work. Resi API: GET /api/v2/leads.

connection_id.description: Connection id (the PMS or CRM that created the lead) (UUID).

created_after.description: Created after this time (ISO-8601, UTC), exclusive.

created_before.description: Created before this time (ISO-8601, UTC), inclusive.

tools.name: resi_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Return one lead with its contact fields, tour booking, lead source and full submission. Resi API: GET /api/v2/leads/{lead}.

tools.name: resi_list_lead_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: List lead sources (where a lead came from, e.g. Zillow or the website) for attribution. Resi API: GET /api/v2/lead-sources.

name.description: Exact lead source name (not a partial match).

tools.name: resi_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List photos, floor plans, PDFs (kind=file) or videos and virtual tours (kind=embed). One kind per call. Filter by the parent record. Resi API: GET /api/v2/media.

kind.description: file = photos and PDFs; embed = video and virtual tour links. Required.

attachable_type.description: Parent type of the media. Use with attachable_id.

tools.name: resi_list_connections
tools.title: List connections
tools.description: List PMS and CRM connections (the syncs that feed inventory and leads), with type, category and enabled state. Resi API: GET /api/v2/connections.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

property_id.description: Property id (connections attached to this property) (UUID).

tools.name: resi_list_connection_logs
tools.title: List connection logs
tools.description: List the sync and import runs of one connection, newest first, with status and error message. Use it to find why a sync failed. Logs are kept 14 days. Resi API: GET /api/v2/connections/{connection}/logs.

event_type.description: Event type, as returned in the log entries.

created_after.description: Runs started after this time (ISO-8601, UTC).

tools.name: resi_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account (staff and service users) with their role. Resi API: GET /api/v2/users.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the name.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Resi
prompts.description: What you can do with Resi here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_units_available_for_rent
prompts.title: Find units available for rent
prompts.description: List the available units in a rent range. Open one unit to see its fees, amenities and synced fields.

prompts.name: review_new_leads_and_their_sources
prompts.title: Review new leads and their sources
prompts.description: List the newest leads and open one to see its tour booking and submission. Use lead data only for the client's own leasing work.

prompts.name: find_out_why_a_pms_sync_failed
prompts.title: Find out why a PMS sync failed
prompts.description: List the connections to the property management system (PMS) and CRM, then read the sync logs of one connection. Logs are kept 14 days.

prompts.name: read_reviews_of_a_property
prompts.title: Read reviews of a property
prompts.description: Find the property, then list its resident and public reviews with rating, source and publish state.

prompts.name: update_a_unit_s_rent_or_availability
prompts.title: Update a unit's rent or availability
prompts.description: Read the unit first. A field in synced_fields is overwritten by the next PMS sync. Then change rent, availability, deposit or specials. The change goes live on the client's Resi sites. Needs a Full access token.
